datasets.name: Archivo SID / Berrutti de Archive.org
datasets.description: Rollos de Archive.org: ZIP originales, PDF extraídos e imágenes finales PNG. Se prepara cada rollo por separado.

contents.images: PDF pages rendered to PNG at 200 DPI by Poppler; no OCR is generated by completion
contents.pdf_text: Some PDFs contain extractable automatic text; coverage and quality are not audited. Not a human reference.
contents.reading_order: PDF page number; embedded text order is not verified
contents.provenance: Original ZIP/PDF retained with hashes; conversion config and pages.jsonl map each image to PDF and page

datasets.training_policy: Requires targets and a source-identity audit before supervised training.

datasets.name: Berrutti v3 — 175 páginas
datasets.description: 175 páginas con transcripción humana completa y 8.975 regiones rectangulares de líneas, cada una con su texto humano.

contents.human_transcription: Full-page UTF-8 text supplied as the reading reference; original sequence preserved
contents.line_bounding_boxes: 8,975 VIA2 rectangles across 175 pages; x/y/width/height in original-image pixels
contents.line_transcription: Human text in each VIA2 region_attributes.text
contents.reading_order: Page reference preserves its supplied text sequence. VIA region array order is not guaranteed to match it; alignment must be audited.
contents.line_images: Not a separate original corpus; crops are derived from page images and coordinates
contents.provenance: Berrutti v3 from the benchmark dataset; original licenses, collaborators, images and references retained

datasets.training_policy: Keep the existing 125/25/25 roll-grouped split and original manifest unchanged.

datasets.name: LUISA / Tesseract — líneas con transcripción
datasets.description: 23.774 imágenes de líneas con transcripción humana LUISA y predicción auxiliar de Tesseract. Fuente distinta de los recortes Berrutti 175.

contents.images: 23,774 PNG line images stored with original .gif filenames
contents.human_transcription: CSV gts and corresponding .gt.txt files; whitespace-only differences in 658 test references are preserved
contents.ocr_prediction: CSV preds and corresponding .pred.txt files from Tesseract; separate from human targets
contents.reading_order: Text within each line; no cross-line page/document reading order provided
contents.provenance: Pinned Memoria.uy GitLab subtree, verified by Git tree identity; original train/test partitions retained

datasets.license_status: No dataset-specific license found in the inspected directory or repository root; preserve upstream notices.
datasets.training_policy: Known overlap with Berrutti held-out pages. Do not merge automatically into its training split. Source-document mapping remains unaudited.
